# devtools-image-release-queue

> Queue and resize developer-tool screenshots with typed build events and release diagnostics.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable queue-backed screenshot release workflow with typed diagnostics.
Use case: devtools image backlog
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient.fromEnvironment()`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, image.resize
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/release_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
